Customer_Intent: Customer wants to know the current status of a specific order and when it is expected to arrive.
Business_Goal: Reduce manual lookup time while giving agents a consistent, fact-based order-status response.
Restricted_Actions: AI must not modify or cancel the order.
Notes: Covers current shipment status, expected delivery date and tracking information when available.

Customer_Intent: Customer reports that an order has not arrived as expected and wants to know what happens next.
Business_Goal: Provide a consistent response based on verified shipment data and the approved Shipping Policy.
Primary_Data_Sources: Customer Request; Order Management System; Shipping Policy
Restricted_Actions: AI must not promise compensation, refund, replacement or another business outcome unless explicitly supported and allowed.
Notes: The final action depends on shipment facts and the applicable policy threshold.

Customer_Intent: Customer reports that the parcel was not received although operational data shows it as delivered.
Business_Goal: Give the agent a grounded response and route a potentially sensitive delivery dispute correctly.
Primary_Data_Sources: Customer Request; Order Management System; Shipping Policy
Restricted_Actions: AI must not claim that the customer received the parcel and must not initiate refund or replacement.
Notes: Known mandatory escalation case under the current business rule.

Customer_Intent: Customer wants to know whether a purchased item can be returned.
Business_Goal: Apply return rules consistently using the relevant order/item facts and Returns Policy.
Primary_Data_Sources: Customer Request; Order Management System; Returns Policy
Restricted_Actions: AI must not grant discretionary exceptions or invent item-specific return rules.
Notes: Expired period, excluded items and exception requests are scenarios of this use case, not separate use cases.

Customer_Intent: Customer wants to know how to return an item.
Business_Goal: Reduce manual explanation effort by providing the approved return procedure consistently.
Primary_Data_Sources: Customer Request; Returns Policy; Order Management System when item-specific rules are needed
Restricted_Actions: AI must not invent process steps or claim that a return has been initiated unless that capability is explicitly added later.
Notes: General procedure questions may require only the Knowledge Base.

Use_Case_Name: Handle Refund Eligibility or Refund Request
Customer_Intent: Customer wants to know whether a refund is possible or asks support to issue a refund.
Business_Goal: Provide policy-grounded refund information while keeping refund decisions and execution under human control.
Primary_Data_Sources: Customer Request; Order Management System; Refund Policy; Business Rules
Restricted_Actions: AI must not issue, confirm, promise or execute a refund.
Notes: Eligibility explanation and an actual refund request are variants of one business intent; execution remains restricted.
